about: The fields of specy_road.orchestration.snapshot(repo_root), schema 1: the read-only orchestration interface (docs/orchestration.md). A field is added or renamed only under a new schema number. 'shape' lists every field; 'status_vocabulary' and 'truth_table' fix each leaf's status; 'unknown' says what an unreadable source sets.

claim.registered_at: registry row's started date, or null

workers.status: the record's state: starting, running, idle, paused_by_limit, completed, failed, terminated
workers.pid_alive: true when the record's wrapper process is running (worker list's alive)
workers.ended_at: the record's last update when its state is completed, failed or terminated; else null

worktrees.branch: the branch checked out there, or null (detached, or not a worktree)
worktrees.dirty: true when git status lists a tracked change or an untracked file

reviews.fresh_for_head: true when commit is the claim branch's tip

keys.leaves: every node id the registry claims, and every node id a readable worker record names that is not a chore
keys.claim: null for a leaf with workers and no registry row
keys.worktrees: every linked or main worktree on the claim's branch, and every worktree a worker record of the leaf names; sorted by path
keys.reviews: every REVIEW-*.md in the leaf's hand-off directory, by file name
keys.leafless_workers: workers on a chore (work/chores/<slug>.json), and each worker record that cannot be read

truth_table.when: a readable worker on the leaf is in a slot state (starting, running, idle, paused_by_limit); with simultaneous workers, one such worker is enough
the leaf is claimed and M15.26's rule reports the claim: no live worker on the leaf, no live session on its branch, no valid READY at the branch tip (a fresh manual claim included)
the leaf's latest readable worker (highest attempt) is completed
the leaf's latest readable worker is failed or terminated
otherwise: claimed with no worker, kept by a person's live session on the branch (manual presence) or a valid READY at the branch tip

unknown.worker record not readable: listed in leafless_workers with its id from the file name and every other field 'unknown'; statuses are judged from the readable records, as M15.26 does
unknown.registry not readable: claim is 'unknown' on each leaf a readable worker names, and status follows rule 1, else rule 2

rows: tests/parity/orchestration_state/ holds one fixture repo per row of the state table and the status each row gets
